title: IPA Core Training Guide
author: Courtney Comrie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7dzhi76
materials: The lab utilizes softwares that use Linux to be run and called. In order to run many of the image analyis softwares, you must first learn to Linux. Cornell University offers a free and comprehensive virtual workshop for beginners in Linux. Complete the training in the link before moving on: https://cvw.cac.cornell.edu/Linux/

steps.title: Gain Linux Box Access
steps.instruction: Coordinate with Dr. Hutchinson or a graduate student to be added to the linux box access list.

steps.title: Configure X2Go Client
steps.instruction: Follow the directions at https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.62whgfe to enter the linux box using the X2Go Client.

steps.title: Set Up HPC Web Interface
steps.instruction: Obtain access to the HPC web interface via the lab account and complete the 'HPC Account Set Up and Access' protocol to familiarize yourself with the interface.

steps.title: Complete Software Training with Practice Data
steps.instruction: Using practice data, execute the following protocols in the specified order to gain exposure to TORTOISE and other software.
